theme.strategy: Nature-Inspired Minimalism. Avoid stark white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds; use 'Paper White' or 'Soft Stone' to reduce eye strain and increase warmth.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers. Adds the 'Premium' touch.

mono.usage: Order IDs, Price calculations, Technical data.

layout_system.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.

grids.marketing: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric layouts for storytelling.
grids.catalog: Responsive Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Focus on large imagery.
grids.dashboard: Dense Grid (Mode B). High data density, clear hierarchy.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on sticky headers: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-green-100.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-primary/10 text-primary hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-full px-6 py-4

cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border/50 hover:shadow-hover transition-all duration-300 group
cards.dashboard: bg-white rounded-xl border border-border p-6 shadow-sm

inputs.style: bg-white border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12 px-4

image_strategy.style: Natural light, high texture, close-ups of leaves/roots. No artificial studio lighting.

landing_page.hero: Split layout. Left: Bold Typography 'Freshness Delivered'. Right: Hero Image with organic shape mask.
landing_page.features: Use 3-column grid with large icons and generous whitespace.
landing_page.cta: Full width section with 'Deep Forest' background and 'Fresh Sprout' button.

subscription_flow.step_indicator: Clean horizontal progress bar. Active step: Primary Color. Inactive: Muted.
subscription_flow.tray_selection: Visual cards. User clicks on the tray image to select. Selected state: Thick Green Border + Checkmark.
subscription_flow.summary: Sticky sidebar on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile. Live price update is critical.

admin_dashboard.tables: Clean rows, no vertical borders. Status badges (Active=Green, Paused=Yellow, Cancelled=Red).
admin_dashboard.metrics: Simple cards with big numbers. Sparkline charts for trends.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle textures.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state.
All images must have alt text.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for Khurpi. Use the provided colors and typography. Implement the subscription flow with a focus on clarity and ease of use. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Ensure the admin panel is functional and data-dense but legible.
